name: learn-kit
description: Pedagogical kit for learnable knowledge artifacts. 3 skills. Primary skill `three-views`: given a topic and source material (project files / external URL / pasted text), generates a user-chosen subset of 1-3 tier learning markdown (foundation 零基础版 / structural 结构版 / challenge 挑战版; v3.1.0 adds Step 1.3 tier multi-select, default all 3 checked, min 1); then optionally renders interactive HTML (dual-mode grounding: repo-code via Explore subagent for concept→file:line; or source-evidence for URL/text sources) and/or pushes to NotebookLM for multimedia artifacts. v3.1.0 redesigns Step 4 into 5-cell granular multi-select (HTML / NLM audio / NLM video / NLM slide_deck / NLM mind_map; default all unchecked); NLM cartesian = len(generated_tiers) × len(selected view-cycled types) + (1 if mind_map). Max 10 NLM artifacts when full defaults. Adaptive quota right-sizing + bounded polling. v4.0.0 (NLM-only BREAKING) rewrites the NLM branch onto the pinned learn-kit-nlm-bridge (connector 0.8.7): requires Node 22+ / uv 0.11.21+ / a user-provided Python 3.12 (installer downloads none), a narrowed 6-tool surface, Gate A/B behavioral consent, and user-run `nlm login` (skill/bridge never log in or bind a Google account). Corpus-hash re-run guard replaces the unsafe (topic, source-count) equivalence. Dual-host: Claude `/learn-kit:three-views`, Codex `$learn-kit:three-views`. v3.2.0 adds two companion in-chat explanation skills: `glossary` (one-paragraph 150–250字 six-slot term card; slash `/learn-kit:glossary <term>`) and `concept` (six-section 500–800字 deep dive with 2 cross-domain examples + failure boundaries; slash `/learn-kit:concept <concept>`) — pure prompt skills (no tools, no files) filling the explanation/Q&A niche three-views explicitly disclaims. See `[ADR]_LearnKit_Explanation_Skills_Addition` for v3.2.0 design; `[ADR]_LearnKit_ThreeViews_HITL_Expansion` for v3.1.0 design; `[ADR]_LearnKit_Consolidation_To_Single_Skill` + Migration §6 for v5.0.x → v6.0.0 baseline.
